title: Tyre 332: The Siege That Filled the Sea with Earth
summary: Tells how, in three hundred thirty-two BC, Alexander the Great had a road of earth built through the sea from the shore to the island to take the Phoenician island city of Tyre, and recounts the siege that lasted seven months. The episode runs from the city's refusal of his request to offer sacrifice at its temple to the Tyrians' fire-ship raid, from the Phoenician and Cypriot fleets going over to Alexander's side to the breach in the wall, the sack of the city, and the island being turned into a peninsula forever.
